segments: Before we start, I'll tell you a little story about my weekend.
I went to my sister's house, and we tried to put a shelf up.
We measured it twice, but we'd put the brackets in the wrong place.
Where did you go for food?
The Italian place near Mum's work.
Mum, Dad, my sister, Auntie Nicky and her boyfriend.
What happened when you got there?
My sister ordered pizza even though she always says she doesn't like cheese.
I checked the menu before we went.
You'd already looked at the menu.
It had pink icing and those silver balls on it.
Did you do anything for your auntie's birthday?
It was a book about birds.
How did you feel about the meal?
We don't have to find a feeling word.
Was there anything else you remember?
Not loads, just near his fork.
What happened at the very end of the visit?
Okay, you remember the restaurant, who was there, what you ate, the cake and giving your auntie the bird book.
I've probably forgotten a detail or two.
The book was about British birds, not all birds.
Anything else you want to add?
Thank you for telling me about it.

What happened when you got there? Child. We sat at the back. My sister ordered pizza even though she always says she doesn't like cheese. Therapist. What did you have? Child. Chicken pasta. It was £12.95. I checked the menu before we went. Therapist. You'd already looked at the menu. What happened after you'd eaten? They brought out a cake. Child. It had pink icing and those silver balls on it. Therapist. Did you do anything for your auntie's birthday? Child. I gave her the present. It was a book about birds. Therapist. How did you feel about the meal? Child. Don't know. Therapist. That's fine. We don't have to find a feeling word. Was there anything else you remember? Child. Her boyfriend spilt some water. Not loads, just near his fork. Therapist. What happened at the very end of the visit? Child. I don't remember. Therapist. Okay, you remember the restaurant, who was there, what you ate, the cake and giving your auntie the bird book. Child. I've probably forgotten a detail or two. Therapist. The book was about British birds, not all birds. Child. Thanks for correcting that. Therapist. A book about British birds. Child. Yeah. Therapist. Anything else you want to add? Child. No. Therapist.
